title: Pretty straightforward fix, as suggested by Alvin Joseph Tang (alvintang3)
description:
Pretty straightforward fix, as suggested by Alvin Joseph Tang (alvintang3)

PPA with the change, for testing, is at
https://launchpad.net/~bryce/+archive/ubuntu/sru.1773324

To test, verify that rabbitmqadmin --version prints an actual version string.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 1a5047a..d07d8cc 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+rabbitmq-server (3.7.8-4ubuntu3) eoan; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/patch: Add fix-string-version.patch to update rabbitmq_management
+    version string during build.  (LP: #1773324)
+
+ -- Alvin Joseph Tang <alvintang@gmail.com>  Sun, 09 Jun 2019 15:51:54 +0800
+
 rabbitmq-server (3.7.8-4ubuntu2) disco; urgency=medium
 
   * Resolve issues with startup of RabbitMQ with erlang provided
diff --git a/debian/patches/fix-string-version.patch b/debian/patches/fix-string-version.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4cadf7a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/fix-string-version.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+Description: Replace %%VSN%% in rabbitmqadmin with version number
+Author: Alvin Joseph Tang, alvintang@gmail.com
+Origin: other, https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/rabbitmq-server/+bug/1773324/+attachment/5269746/+files/3-1.0-1ubuntu2.debdiff
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/rabbitmq-server/+bug/1773324
+Bug-Debian: https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=908690
+Reviewed-by: Bryce Harrington <bryce@canonical.com>
+Last-Update: 2019-06-13
+
+Index: rabbitmq-server-3.6.10/deps/rabbitmq_management/Makefile
+===================================================================
+--- rabbitmq-server-3.6.10.orig/deps/rabbitmq_management/Makefile
++++ rabbitmq-server-3.6.10/deps/rabbitmq_management/Makefile
+@@ -40,6 +40,9 @@ include erlang.mk
+ # Distribution.
+ # --------------------------------------------------------------------
+ 
++all::
++	$(verbose) sed -i 's/%%VSN%%/$(PROJECT_VERSION)/' bin/rabbitmqadmin
++
+ list-dist-deps::
+ 	@echo bin/rabbitmqadmin
+ 
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0003352
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+fix-string-version.patch
